settings.title: Settings
settings.maint.heading: Maintenance mode
settings.maint.intro: Shows visitors a maintenance page (HTTP 503). Signed-in administrators keep seeing the site normally.
settings.maint.enabledHelp: While active, the maintenance page is served for all public pages.
settings.maint.overrideHelp: The standard page automatically uses the active template's colours. To fully customise it, edit the active template under Files → maintenance.html.
maintenance.defaultMessage: Our website is currently undergoing maintenance. Please check back shortly.
settings.errorsIntro: Assign a custom page for “not found” (404) and server errors. Unset = built-in default message.
settings.smtpIntro: Outgoing mail server credentials for form notifications.
settings.smtpTestHelp: Sends a test email to the sender address using the currently entered values (without saving).
settings.faviconHelp: Small icon in the browser tab. Optional — if unset, the logo is used.
settings.contactEmailHelp: Currently not used for sending — inquiries appear under “Inquiries”.
backup.title: Backup
backup.heading: Backup & Restore
backup.createIntro: Choose which sections to include in the backup. A ZIP file (content + media) will be downloaded.
backup.usersWarn: Contains credentials (password hashes). Only enable for migrations to a new instance and keep the backup file secure.
backup.restoreIntro: Restore a previously created backup. Only the sections contained in the backup are overwritten — sections not in the backup stay unchanged.
backup.confirmLabel: I confirm that the sections contained in the backup will be overwritten.
backup.schedIntro: Automatically creates backups on the server at an interval and keeps the most recent ones. Section selection as for a manual backup.
backup.restoreStoredConfirm: Restore this backup now? Included sections will be overwritten.
templates.title: Templates
templates.activeNotice: This template is currently active. Changes take effect on the website immediately.
templates.name: Name
templates.customJsHelp: Runs before the closing </body> of every public page.
templates.layoutHtmlHelp: Optional & advanced. Replaces the body structure. Variables: {{content}} (page content, required), {{nav}}, {{footer_nav}}, {{toolbar}}, {{logo}}, {{site_name}}, {{footer_text}}, {{year}}. The <head> (fonts/design/favicon) is kept. Without {{content}} the default layout is used.
templates.menuLoopHelp: Menus: {{menu:slot}} outputs the whole menu as links. For custom markup per entry: {{#menu:slot}}<li><a href="{{url}}"{{target}}>{{icon}}{{label}}</a></li>{{/menu:slot}} — available are {{label}}, {{url}}, {{icon}}, {{target}}.
templates.menusIntro: A custom layout (“Advanced” tab) can include named menus via {{menu:slot}}. Here you set which of your internal menus fills each slot.
templates.menusNoSlots: This template currently uses no custom layout with named menu slots. The default layout includes the built-in menus (main menu, footer, toolbar) directly — no mapping needed. Add {{menu:name}} to your layout in the “Advanced” tab and save, then the slots appear here to map.
templates.internalMenusHelp: These menus are available to map (manage under “Menu”).
templates.menuMappingHelp: Map each menu slot used in the layout to a real menu. Without a mapping, the slot name is used directly as the menu key.
templates.starterConfirm: The current layout in the field will be overwritten. Continue?
templates.slotsDetected: Detected menu slots (map them below after saving):
templates.slotsNone: No menu slots yet. Use {{menu:name}} or the example layout and save.
templates.layoutInactiveHint: The custom layout only takes effect if it contains {{content}} — otherwise the default layout stays active.
templates.versionHint: Format version of this template. Older templates are converted to the current version automatically at startup.
templates.pagesIntro: Custom layouts per page type. Each page type has placeholders ({{token}}) filled with the content. If you leave a field at the default, the built-in layout applies automatically — even after engine updates.
templates.postLayoutHelp: Controls the structure of a single blog post page (/blog/…). Use the placeholders below. The post body is inserted via {{post_body}}.
templates.tok.title: Heading
tplfiles.intro: The layout files of this template. Each is optional — if empty, the built-in default behavior applies; if filled, it is loaded/included. Click to edit.
tplfiles.body.desc: Overall layout of the <body>. Only takes effect if it contains {{content}} — otherwise the default layout stays active. Menus via {{menu:slot}}.
tplfiles.article.desc: Layout of a single blog detail page (/blog/…). Without customization the built-in layout is used.
tplfiles.styles.desc: Additional CSS. Included as <style> on every page when present.
tplfiles.script.desc: Additional JavaScript. Included before </body> on every page when present.
tplfiles.maintenance.desc: Maintenance page (complete HTML document). Shown while maintenance mode is active.

setup.accountIntro: Set your credentials. The email address is your login.

templates.tokContent: Page content (required for the custom layout)
settings.canonicalHelp: Public base URL of the site (for the sitemap, robots.txt and canonical links). Behind an HTTPS reverse proxy, enter the real https:// address here.
settings.sitemapHelp: Serves /sitemap.xml (all published pages) and a /robots.txt pointing to it — for search engines (Google Search Console etc.). Enabled by default.
settings.ga4Help: Enter only the measurement ID (starts with “G-”). The matching gtag.js snippet is generated automatically in the <head>. For other tools, leave this empty and add the code below.

templates.tabHintDesigner: Appearance: colors, typography, layout and header.
templates.tabHintFiles: The template's layout files (HTML/CSS/JS) — click to edit in the editor.
templates.tabHintParams: Technical: menu mapping and the parameters for users.
templates.paramsHelp: Parameters a user of this template can set under “Customize” — without editing the template. Usable in the template as {{param:id}} (in styles.css or body.html). The ID is generated from the label.
dashboard.setupBanner: Welcome! Set up the admin account, theme, e-mail and first page in a few steps.
settings.cloudIntro: Connects this instance to a MatCMS.Cloud. The cloud watches versions, notifies about updates and outages, and can update this instance when it runs on the same Docker host. The connection is always outbound from here — no port needs opening.
settings.cloudLocalHelp: The cloud found this container on its own Docker host.
settings.cloudRemoteHelp: This instance runs on a different host — run updates here.
settings.cloudNoContainer: none detected (not running in a container)
settings.cloudTokenHelp: Instance id and token are created in the cloud under Instances, Add instance. The token is stored encrypted and never shown here again.
settings.cloudJoinHelp: Enter the cloud URL and a profile's join code — the instance fetches its own credentials and configuration. Both are shown in the cloud under Instances, Add instance.
settings.cloudManual: Advanced: enter instance id and token manually
settings.cloudAwaitingApprovalHint: The cloud knows this instance but hands out configuration only after approval.
settings.cloudPreviewHint: Result of a dry run through the exact same logic as a real apply — nothing was changed.
settings.cloudApplySelectedHint: Applies the ticked items now. Unticking only defers, it does not exclude: while the instance differs from the profile revision, the next sync (within a minute) brings the rest automatically.
settings.cloudReportHint: Result of the last apply from the cloud. This exact list is what the cloud is told as well.
settings.codeIntro: Custom HTML/script code embedded on every page — e.g. Google Analytics, Matomo, Meta Pixel or a consent tool. Managed here in the admin only.
settings.codeHeadPlaceholder: <!-- e.g. verification meta tags, consent tool -->
templates.customizeHelp: Adjust the settings this template’s designer exposed — without editing the template itself.
templates.customizeEmpty: This template exposes no settings to customize.

editor.autoTranslateTitle: Machine-translate all texts of this version from the default language
editor.autoTranslateConfirm: All texts of this version will be re-translated from the default language and OVERWRITTEN. Continue?
settings.translate.heading: Machine translation
settings.translate.intro: Powers the ⚡ button in the page editor (auto-translate a version from the default language). DeepL: free API key with 500,000 chars/month (key ends in “:fx”). LibreTranslate: your own instance (e.g. Docker container) — free and unlimited.
settings.translate.apiKeyHelp: DeepL: required. LibreTranslate: only if your instance requires a key.
settings.translate.urlHelp: e.g. http://libretranslate:5000 (container on the same Docker network) or a public instance.
